purpose: Baseline vNext runtime-reset inventory. Every shipped relay script and cross-skill runtime edge is enumerated before lifecycle behavior changes.

roleModel.detected: Conservative lexical signals for direct CLI/store/event/evidence/Done Criteria/host access. This is not claimed to be semantically exhaustive.
roleModel.reviewedSemantic: Human-reviewed seed contract for indirect or delegated runtime access that lexical scanning cannot infer. The CI checker owns an independent copy and requires every seed here.

roleVocabulary.cli-entry: Executable CLI surface detected from direct process.argv/main-module access.
roleVocabulary.run-record:*: Conceptual run-record create/read/write responsibility carried into vNext migration.
roleVocabulary.event:*: Event journal read or append access.
roleVocabulary.evidence:*: Execution evidence read or write access.
roleVocabulary.done-criteria:*: Frozen Done Criteria read or write access.
